page: Google Cloud Platform c4-highmem-24-lssd is a memory-optimized server instance powered by an Intel Xeon 6985P-C processor with an x86_64 architecture. It features 24 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 12 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. The system is equipped with 186.0 GB of RAM, providing 7.75 GB of memory per core. Local storage is bundled, consisting of 4 NVMe SSDs totaling 1343 GB of high-speed local capacity. No GPUs are present in this configuration.

Benchmark results indicate top-tier performance in single-threaded tasks, with Geekbench single-core scores and gzip compression single-threaded speeds reaching the top 10% of tested instances. The CPU's advanced instruction sets, including AVX-512 and Intel Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX), support accelerated workloads. For instance, LLM inference text generation for small (135M) models ranks in the top 10% at 394.37 tokens/sec, while prompt processing for the same model is in the top 25%. Multi-core performance, such as Geekbench multi-core and image processing, is strong, placing in the top 25%.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the c4-highmem-24-lssd offers a high-density memory-to-vCPU ratio alongside integrated high-speed NVMe storage, reducing the need for external storage attachments for data-intensive tasks. This profile is highly suited for memory-intensive and storage-reliant workloads, such as database operations, text and image processing, and small-scale language model inference. The combination of a massive 504 MB L3 cache and dedicated CPU allocation ensures predictable performance for enterprise applications.
description: Google Cloud Platform c4-highmem-24-lssd is a memory-optimized server featuring 24 dedicated vCPUs and 12 physical cores powered by an Intel Xeon 6985P-C x86_64 processor running at 2.3 GHz. It is equipped with 186.0 GB of RAM (7.75 GB per core) and 1343 GB of local NVMe SSD storage across 4 drives, with no GPU acceleration. The instance delivers top-tier single-core performance, ranking in the top 10% for Geekbench single-core and single-threaded gzip compression. It also demonstrates strong multi-core capabilities and efficient small-model LLM inference. With its large 504 MB L3 cache and integrated high-speed local storage, this server is highly optimized for memory-intensive databases, text and image processing, and data-heavy enterprise workloads.
